item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed how Main Roads handled misconduct allegations involving two managers.
item.support: This report details the Commission's review of the actions taken by Main Roads in dealing with these allegations of misconduct.

item.text: The Commission considered the external investigation thorough, but found Main Roads had initially done little to address wider misconduct risks.
item.support: Limited action had been taken to understand and address the broader serious misconduct risks.

item.text: The Commission made three recommendations covering financial audits, procurement oversight and fixed asset policies.

item.text: After considering further action by Main Roads, the Commission concluded that all three recommendations could be closed.
item.support: The Commission considers Main Roads has taken appropriate steps to address the recommendations.

item.quote: On the evidence available, the Commission considers the conclusions reached that both managers engaged in misconduct were open to be made.
The Commission considers all recommendations closed.
